name: Large-order governor safety (30+ lines / high-qty Power)
what_it_tests: The procedure handles a large order (many lines, high-qty Power, tiered matrices, PowerBranching splits) within CPU/SOQL/DML governor limits on Reprice-All and order completion
proc_mechanism: Whole procedure on order context; Aggregate Price / List Operations bulk-safe; batched line creation; deprecated duplicate line-type subflow removed; Apex-stamp + flow-guard for high-qty Power
expected_behavior: Order reprice/complete succeeds; no SOQL:101, CPU limit, or 'too many DML' error
test_setup: Order with 30+ lines incl. high-qty (150+) Power / 500+ node tiers, Reprice-All + complete

prior_run.actual: Built Draft Order 00095656 (801WC00000lzWJFYA2) = 35 OrderItems incl MessengerConsole Power qty 5000. REST Force-reprice (Order PATCH) returned isSuccess=true, errorResponse=[]. All 35/35 lines got NetUnitPrice (was null). qty-5000 Power line NetUnit=11487, NetTotal=57435000 (11487x5000), stayed ONE line, 0 split clones, line count still 35. Order TotalAmount recomputed 57573162.35 -> 57516319. 2nd reprice also isSuccess=true. No governor breach.
prior_run.notes: K-03 governor safety. SC-3366 SOQL:101 fix (v13 OrderSubmissionValidator) governs the completion path; SC-3447 P3 (no-split seat/sentinel Power) governs convert. Reprice-All on order context = the V21 bulk path; verified clean on 35 lines incl qty-5000 Power. Note: the platform RLM place action has a hard 'Too many Order Products' input cap (hit on a 1244-line Draft order 00057076) - that is a platform request-size limit, NOT the Apex governor defect K-03 targets, so a sub-100-line order is the correct K-03 fixture per the '30+ lines' setup.
